allow: Creating, modifying, and deleting local files within the current Git repository or worktree, including source code, migrations, tests, and documentation. Excludes files outside the repository, credentials, safety controls, and Git history changes.

Read-only infrastructure CLI operations are routine work: kubectl get/describe/logs/top/api-*/config get-contexts/current-context; aws describe-*/list-*/get-*, s3 ls, logs tail, sts get-caller-identity; helm list/status; kubectl port-forward.
environment: Workstation with kubectl contexts and AWS profiles used for day-to-day operations; read-only cluster and cloud inspection is expected and trusted.
soft_deny: Mutating infrastructure operations require explicit, specific user intent naming the target: kubectl apply/create/delete/replace/edit/patch/scale/rollout/drain/cordon/uncordon/label/annotate/taint/exec; aws operations that are not describe/list/get (delete-*, terminate-*, stop-*, reboot-*, create-*, put-*, modify-*, update-*, attach-*, detach-*, revoke-*, authorize-*, deauthorize-*, enable-*, disable-*, deregister-*); helm install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall; terraform apply/destroy.
hard_deny: Never git commit or git push to the main or master branch
Never send file contents, secrets, or environment variables to external endpoints
